questions.stem: In the clinician's note, explain why a cover letter claims fit for the post.

answer.exemplar: A French cover letter claims that the applicant fits the specific post, rather than listing every job held. This targeted claim shows motivation and alignment with the employer's needs.

questions.explanation: The letter claims fit for the post to show motivation and alignment. Listing jobs belongs to the CV, not the letter.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Why the opening interview question looks odd
questions.learningObjective: Explain odd interview question with explanation
questions.stem: In the clinician's note, explain why the opening interview question can look odd.

answer.exemplar: The opening interview question often asks the candidate to present themselves, which can look odd because it is very open. It is nonetheless standard, since it lets the candidate frame their own story.

questions.explanation: The opening question is very open, so it can look odd. It is standard because it lets the candidate frame their own story.
